# Brewing tea: a short guide

Good tea needs three things: clean water, the right temperature and patience.

## Temperature

Green tea likes water around 80 degrees. Black tea can take boiling water.

| Tea | Temperature | Time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Green | 80 | 60 s |
| Black | 95 | 180 s |

```python
def seconds(tea: str) -> int:
    return {"green": 60, "black": 180}[tea]
```

See the [tea encyclopedia](https://example.com/tea-en) for more.

The second infusion is often sweeter than the first.
Write down what you taste and compare after a month.
Rinse the teapot when you are done.
